notes.title: 007 First Light: Wishlist Milestones
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3768760/007_First_Light/

The mission is simple: rally together and unlock the Wishlist milestones for 007 First Light. With every milestone reached, new in-game and community rewards are unlocked, adding style, sophistication, and a secret reward. 

Each milestone is more than a number: it’s a gateway to obtain gear, slick visual upgrades, and insider access. Here’s your dossier of what’s at stake:

[list]
[*] Milestone 1: Equip Bond with a unique skin and enhance your desktop with animated 007-themed wallpapers.
[*] Milestone 2: Add flair to your fieldwork with a custom gadget skin, and stream like an agent with a bespoke overlay.
[*] Milestone 3: Go in style with a Deluxe agent skin, plus unlock a developer AMA.
[*] Milestone 4: Confidential. The contents of this final reward are top secret, for now…
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647043/0ece9a544459344149912da315979d0ff0f448e1.jpg[/img]

Wishlist 007 First Light today, and obtain exclusive rewards tied to the game!

notes.title: Le Chiffre Awaits in Paris: Unlock an Exclusive Reward in 007 First Light
notes.content:
Mads Mikkelsen reprises his role as Le Chiffre, the calculating and cold-blooded financier from “Casino Royale” (2006). After a catastrophic financial misstep, Le Chiffre has resurfaced, orchestrating an exclusive high-stakes poker game at the opulent Casino Monarchique in Paris.  

Agent 47 has been dispatched. His mission: infiltrate the game, blend in among the elite, and eliminate the threat before Le Chiffre can ensure havoc is being wreaked across the world.  

The Banker Elusive Target is available for [b]free [/b]until [b]July 6.[/b] 

While getting ready for 007 First Light, this crossover is the perfect warm-up for Agents who like their missions stylish and their enemies dangerous.
